snippet.title: Intoxico (first trailer)
snippet.description:
Intoxico is a party game where you use your phones as controllers to play 26 different mini games against your friends, like drawing, memory, funniest answer, geo guess, roulette and more.
All you need is a webbrowser!

Play for free on https://intoxico.com
